newsitem.title: SPAIN: FORECAST-Spanish building sector to pick up in 98.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Spanish building sector to pick up in 98.

text.p: Spanish building sector activity should pick up in 1998, although it is likely to remain almost unchanged this year, Argentaria forecast in a study released on Thursday.

After national account data showed building sector activity rose 2.7 percent in the quarter, despite a fall of 2.3 percent year on year, the Argentaria indicator shows improvement continued in the second quarter (this year), the group said.

"Construction of new housing, boosted by higher householders' income and by the fall in interest rates, will boost the sector despite public investments (which) are expected to remain low," the report said.
